title: Sigil and Salt Again
author: Xanthe Yarrow
blurb: Astrid Lockridge, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
